free_tier.stated: Trusted Platform: 256 MB per player (Managed Partners) / 64 MB per player (Creators Program). Universal Platform: 64 MB per player. Global: 256 MB. No total-title byte cap published.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Not metered separately in the Title Storage docs; access is through Xbox services.

tooling: Xbox services REST endpoints + GDK; data must be hex or base64 encoded because Title Storage 'doesn't process encoded data'.
chaining: 256 MB per player x unlimited players, but the per-write encoding overhead (base64 = +33%) eats the ceiling, and Managed Partner status is a gate for the 256 MB tier.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: 64 MB per player on the Creator-Program tier; request-rate: ~60 reads or writes per hour per session, then throttled. Binary must be base64/hex encoded. Retention: not documented as expiring. Data persists with the title.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Throttles to roughly one call per minute averaged over an hour-long session, so bulk transfer is painful; the 256 MB tier requires Managed Partner status rather than self-serve signup.
